text: Residents have reached out to me with concerns about speeding on Woodycrest Avenue between Aldwych and Sammon Avenue. The section of Woodycrest Avenue between Sammon Avenue and Mortimer Avenue, as well as the section between Selkirk Street and Danforth Avenue already have speed humps. Residents are looking to fill in the gap of speed humps on this section, since they have witnessed vehicles speeding up in this section. This is also a residential area, very close to the disruptive Ontario Line construction. For the sake of public safety, I am supportive of the installation of speed humps on this street.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (three speed humps) on Woodycrest Avenue, between Sammon Avenue and Selkirk Street, generally as shown in Attachment 2 to the letter (July 7, 2026) from Councillor Paula Fletcher.
